hero: Inside an auto repair shop: a car on a lift under warm evening light, an engine hoist and a parts shelf. Flat vector, DARK deep green overall, bright red highlights, off-white accents. The vehicle is a generic compact hatchback (never a pickup truck, never a muscle car, never a classic car) with a plain thin horizontal slot grille with NO emblem, logo or oval badge anywhere, plain rectangular headlights, no racing stripes, shown from the front three-quarter: no recognizable make or model. The lifted car sits fully BETWEEN the two lift posts: both posts stand clearly beside the car, never in front of it or passing through its body; the lift arms reach under the car from the sides. Subject weighted to the right two thirds; the left third is plain dark background that fades smoothly (no hard edge, no panel, no frame). Interior only: no building exterior, no text, no signs, no logos, no license plates, no people, no hands.
